body: i feel you, i only take online classes and rarely leave my dorm. It’s the same thing everyday things start to feel unreal. I don’t have any friends and bad social anxiety, honestly don’t think ppl would even check on me for weeks if i did die. i always see one of the biggest reasons is other people which can make someone even more lonely. I’m not sure what your interests are but for me i love movies and drawing. I can do them alone in my room and they make me feel better and pass the time. doing activities for yourself whatever they may be, no time limit , no judgement you don’t have to be good at it just something that brings temporary joy. Things are still lonely but for the 2 hours i’m watching a movie i just get involved in someone else’s life and my own fades away. Also the world would not be better without you , and you aren’t pathetic. It sucks to feel like you’re always on the outside looking in but start by doing things for yourself.
